api.execution: Read-only deterministic validation/proposals in existing workflow_assurance.py. Read declared local artifacts/Git objects/environment; never execute receipt commands, write files/state, contact network, start subprocess commands other than existing read-only Git helpers, or add CLI/scheduler/state store. plan always invokes actual receipt validation internally, not a forgeable caller-supplied passed token.
api.reuse: Reuse json_value/parse_json/canonical/relative_path/regular_file, validate_identity/compare_identity, immutable Git helpers and verify_record_update. Validate approved contract, operator/prerequisite verdicts and run state with existing applicable shipped schemas through jsonschema; schema validity is followed by strict relational/type/proof checks. Existing validate.sh/verify_lib.sh remain repository validation authority, not copied/replaced engines. No existing schema edits.
api.trust_boundary: Trusted Root supplies independently selected policy and producer/artifact expectations from an approved contract and actual operator authority. Receipt contents cannot select their own expectations. Local recorded producer IDs, SHA256, Git objects and schemas establish structure/binding/integrity, not authentication, consent or execution attestation. Caller is responsible for trusted capture/transport and observing candidate/environment; APIs neither authenticate humans nor claim protection from a malicious caller controlling policy and artifacts.
api.policy_shape: Exact object: schema_version(integer1), repository, feature_id, stage, operation_id, candidate(existing115 identity), contract(artifact reference), operator(artifact reference), producer(nonempty agent_id/session_id object), prerequisites(ordered list), commands(ordered list), from_status, to_status, at(nonempty timestamp), recovery(null or artifact reference). Nonempty operation/feature/stage strings; stage names limited to contract-approved/source-ready/qa-passed/evidence-captured/feature-complete. Artifact reference exact path/sha256/revision fields: canonical regular relative file path, lowercase64hex digest, real lowercase40hex immutable Git commit. Prerequisite entries additionally name kind and expected closed verdict shape; command entries exact argv(nonempty string array), expected_exit(integer0), proof_kind(success or semantic-negative), diagnostic(nonempty exact line). Policy is independently frozen/reviewed input, never loaded from untrusted receipt fields.
api.receipt_shape: Exact object: schema_version(integer1), repository, feature_id, stage, operation_id, status, candidate(existing115 identity), producer, contract_ref, operator_ref, prerequisites, checks, verdict. Binding fields must exactly equal policy. status enum pending/running/passed/failed/invalidated; only passed may validate for advancement. checks ordered one-to-one with policy commands: exact argv, executed(exact bool), outcome(success/semantic-negative/unrun/setup-error/unsupported/transport-error/failed), exit_code(integer or null), stdout and stderr artifact references. verdict is existing strict AGF final_verdict plus three blocking arrays; extra JSON verdict metadata allowed. Inputs finite acyclic exact JSON objects; booleans never substitute for integers, no coercion/default approval.
api.candidate_binding: Validate both candidate identities with existing115 validator and require compare_identity true, including repository/source commit/tree/source-contract-test-tool assessed digests/environment/record masks. Require actual immutable source commit/tree exists and each protected source/test/tool file bytes/mode matches the bound Git object and assessed digest; contract authority is read at its immutable approved reference, not required to remain byte-identical after Root lifecycle metadata completion. Trusted policy must bind all relevant assessed inputs; unknown dependencies invalidate. Current observed protected objects/environment must match; do not substitute ambient HEAD for assessed revision. Evidence-only descendants may change HEAD without invalidation when protected inputs remain identical and only explicitly declared record ownership applies; do not require HEAD==base or rewrite old seals.
api.authority: Verify immutable approved contract identity/feature and both real independent pre-code approval references where required, using strict approved is True plus three exactly empty arrays. Operator artifact is trusted caller-selected actual decision, scope/repository/stage/target candidate binding and approved exactTrue; may reference already recorded standing authorization and its explicit Root application, no repeated human approval requirement. Refuse a wrong target, missing decision, approval1 or automated gate masquerading as operator consent. Policy's producer must equal recorded receipt producer; identity claims remain local recorded provenance.
api.prerequisites: Policy must include fixed minimum stage prerequisites: contract-approved requires mode-a and contract-review; source-ready requires approved-contract and independent provisional-bundle; qa-passed requires mode-b; evidence-captured requires fresh-qa; feature-complete requires fresh-qa and evidence-capture. Additional independently declared prerequisites are conjunctive. Each receipt reference must match policy kind/path/digest/revision and its artifact's actual bytes and candidate binding, with relevant existing schema and strict gate arrays approved. Historical predecessor118/119 proofs keep their original tree/context and explicit dependency role; never pretend they prove current120 or require future120 QA/capture/self-completion before initial Source. Selection's pending main-CI is superseded only by actual E119/pr100-main-ci.json and E120/source-prerequisite.json before initial Source.
api.actual_execution: For every required check require executed is True, actual strict integer exit_code==policy.expected_exit==0, exact argv/order and outcome==policy.proof_kind. Read stdout/stderr bytes through pinned artifact refs and require the independently expected diagnostic as an exact output line, with no missing/duplicate check. Receipt's passed/exit/diagnostic claims alone cannot pass. New120 success obligations cannot be satisfied by nonzero semantic red, absent API/setup2, unsupported or transport errors even if an author relabels expected_exit. Existing historical intentional-negative contexts remain unchanged and are not claimed as universally covered by this new adapter.
api.validation_result: verify returns independent deep copy of the validated receipt, not an authorization token. Preserve all input bytes/objects; no aliases. Malformed/wrong-shaped/schema-invalid/nonfinite/cyclic/missing/unsafe/symlink/stale/bad-operator/bad-producer/bad-prerequisite/bad-command/nonpassing data raises existing AssuranceError with nonempty bounded diagnostic; translate relevant JSON/schema/Git/OS/recursion errors, no successful output.
api.transition: plan validates existing state with current run_state schema, repository binding and strict typed history; calls verify internally for supplied receipt. Compute SHA256 of canonical complete receipt. Return exactly action, state, receipt, reason. For action advance, return deep-copy state with only status from policy.from_status to policy.to_status, updated_at=policy.at, and one history event {at,event:'wa-receipt-transition',operation_id,feature_id,stage,candidate_sha256,receipt_sha256}; use verify_record_update for only /status,/updated_at,/history. Require actual state.status==from_status and existing statuses valid under schema. Root alone applies corresponding canonical lifecycle/evidence then derived state; this proposal never itself marks any feature complete or promises atomic cross-file writes.
api.idempotence: Search existing history for exact event/operation_id across all stages/candidates. Exactly one matching full event and status==to_status returns action noop with state byte-semantically unchanged and independent copies; no second append/status advance. Same operation reused with different receipt/candidate/stage, duplicate recorded events, replay with incompatible status or unowned history mutation rejects. No other state fields/counters/budgets/authority/prefix may change. Noop event identity excludes mutable current HEAD and uses immutable candidate/receipt digests.
api.recovery: receipt=None means missing, never passed. With no independently pinned recovery artifact return action rerun-required, unchanged state, receipt null and explicit reason; no command execution/counter reset. With recovery ref, read exact immutable approved prior receipt bytes and verify all normal policy/candidate/operator/prerequisite/actual proof requirements; require canonical digest matches any existing operation event. Return action republish, unchanged state and verified receipt for Root to restore at its declared transport destination, not to invent new proof or append history. Missing recovery artifact returns rerun-required; corrupt/unsafe/mismatched artifact rejects. After actual republication, normal planner yields advance once or noop when already recorded. Preserve original failures; no recursive retries/automatic recovery loop.

verification.acceptance_test: AT1 reject-missing-operator: valid scoped standing-authorization application passes; absent/wrong-target/nonbool operator fails.
AT2 reject-wrong-candidate: exact assessed candidate and permitted evidence-only HEAD continuity pass; changed protected objects/environment or different receipt target rejects.
AT3 reject-unrun: actual independently expected command/exit/output proof passes; unexecuted/null/absent proof cannot pass despite passed label.
AT4 reject-setup: legitimate actual success passes; setup/unsupported/transport outcome or expected_exit manipulation cannot authorize advancement.
AT5 reject-pending: pending remains nonpassing; restored complete actual receipt passes.
AT6 reject-running: running remains nonpassing; restored complete actual receipt passes.
AT7 reject-failed: failed/nonzero/strict-type wrong exit remains failure; restored actual success passes.
AT8 reject-invalidated: invalidated/stale prerequisite receipt rejects; valid bound fresh receipt passes.
AT9 idempotent-replay: real valid first proposal advances once; same complete receipt yields noop with identical history/status and no alias/input mutation.
AT10 reject-double-advance: conflicting same operation ID, duplicate event, changed stage/candidate/receipt or incompatible current state rejects; legitimate identical replay remains noop.

AT11 recover-missing-receipt: missing proof produces unchanged rerun-required; exact pinned valid artifact yields republish only; restored receipt advances once/noops if recorded, corrupt/wrong artifact rejects.
